deduplication_decisions: GHSA-7x8x is one root-discovery item with bounded enterprise active-organization variants because the same missing predicate is repaired across the controller/service family.
GHSA-27w2 OpenAI-assistant raw lookups and assistant-delete raw lookup are separate roots: their vulnerable lookup expressions are in distinct services and do not call the generic helper.
GHSA-27w2 TTS getVoices is a bounded variant of R04 because it reaches the same getCredentialData raw lookup as GHSA-hqvm.
MCP executable policy and cwd policy remain separate roots because they protect different process capability fields and are repaired by distinct guards.
